meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 当你把某个 PR 交给它照看时,它会反复检查 PR 的合并状态、评论、审查对话和自动化检查(CI);发现真问题就修复并提交,直到检查通过、评论全部处理完、可以合并才停手。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit”或“monitor”,或要求盯着某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI 直到问题全解决时触发。

say.text: 用 babysit 盯住 PR #42,直到能合并。
say.note: Claude 会持续检查和修复,合并前不停。

say.text: 帮我持续监控 #42 的评论和 CI,有问题就修。
say.note: 以 30–60 秒间隔轮询,直到干净。

say.text: 盯住 #42,把未解决的 review 线程都处理掉。
say.note: 它会修复代码并解析过期的线程。

howto.what_en: When asked to watch a PR, it repeatedly checks merge state, comments, review threads, and CI; fixes real issues with commits and pushes, and only stops when checks pass, no actionable comments remain, and no review threads are unresolved.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "babysit", "monitor", or ask it to keep watching a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Use babysit on PR #42 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: It will keep checking and fixing until merge.

say_en.text: Keep monitoring #42's comments and CI, fix anything wrong.
Watch #42 and clear all unresolved review threads.
say_en.note: It fixes code and resolves stale threads.
